title: Count the words
description:
Write `std::map<std::string, int> wordCounts(const std::vector<std::string>& words)` that maps each distinct word to how many times it appears.

The counting idiom is one line: `++counts[word];` Asking a map for a key it does not have creates the entry with a value of 0, which is exactly the right starting point for a count.
hints: One loop over the words with `++counts[word];` inside. A `std::map` keeps its keys sorted, so the result is in alphabetical order for free.
